info.title: AFFiNE MCP Gateway
info.summary: Multi-tenant Model Context Protocol server for self-hosted AFFiNE.
info.description:
One deployment, many AFFiNE users and domains. Your application opens an MCP session per user over
Streamable HTTP (`POST /mcp`) and then calls tools with JSON-RPC.

## Flow
1. `POST /mcp` with `method: initialize`, the gateway token in `Authorization`, and the user's AFFiNE
   destination and credentials in `X-Affine-*` headers. The response carries an `Mcp-Session-Id` header.
2. Send `notifications/initialized`, then `tools/list` or `tools/call` with the same `Mcp-Session-Id`.
   `X-Affine-*` headers are only read on `initialize` and are ignored afterwards.
3. `DELETE /mcp` with the session id when done. Idle sessions close automatically.

## Tools
The 106 tools below are generated from the running server. They are MCP tools, not separate
HTTP endpoints: each is invoked as `tools/call` on `POST /mcp` with `params.name` and `params.arguments`.
They appear in the **Webhooks** section purely because OpenAPI has no native notion of JSON-RPC methods.

## Credits
Based on [affine-mcp-server](https://github.com/DAWNCR0W/affine-mcp-server) by DAWNCR0W (MIT).

servers.description: Your deployment (for example the Dokploy domain).

post.description: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. The first request of a session must be `initialize` and must include the tenant headers. Later requests must send `Mcp-Session-Id`. Responses are JSON or an SSE stream (`Accept: application/json, text/event-stream`).

parameters.name: X-Affine-Url
parameters.description: `initialize` only. AFFiNE base URL, HTTPS. Its host must be in the server allowlist.

parameters.name: X-Affine-Password
parameters.description: `initialize` only. Plain password; Latin-1 safe characters only.

parameters.name: X-Affine-Cookie
parameters.description: `initialize` only. Signed-in AFFiNE `Cookie` header (alternative to email/password).

parameters.name: X-Affine-Token
parameters.description: `initialize` only. Bearer token accepted by that AFFiNE server (alternative).

200.description: JSON-RPC response. `initialize` also returns the `Mcp-Session-Id` response header.

400.description: Missing/invalid tenant headers (initialize) or malformed JSON-RPC.

401.description: Wrong gateway token, or AFFiNE sign-in failed for the supplied credentials.

403.description: The AFFiNE host is not in `AFFINE_MCP_TENANT_ALLOWED_HOSTS`.

404.description: Unknown or expired `Mcp-Session-Id`; open a new session.

delete.description: Releases the session and the credentials held in memory for it.

200.description: Session closed.
Server is up.

get.description: In multi-tenant mode there is no single upstream, so this reports `upstream: per-tenant`.

post.description:
Add a shape, connector, text, or group to the AFFiNE edgeless canvas surface. Shapes support rect/ellipse/diamond/triangle with fill, stroke, and text. Connectors draw arrows between shapes (by id) or between absolute points. Use for building diagrams programmatically. Style fields that don't apply to the chosen element type are reported in the response 'ignored' list (mirrors update_surface_element).

_Hints: writes data._

Invoke with `tools/call` on `POST /mcp`.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID (optional if default set)

radius.description: Corner radius for rect (0.1 = rounded). Shape only.

filled.description: Whether shape is filled (default true). Shape only.

fillColor.description: Fill color. Prefer the `--affine-palette-shape-<color>` family (yellow/orange/red/magenta/purple/navy/blue/green/teal/grey/white/black). These are fixed colors — AFFiNE shape colors are not theme-adaptive by design. Shape only.

strokeColor.description: Stroke color. Prefer the `--affine-palette-line-<color>` family (same color names as fillColor). Fixed colors, not theme-adaptive. Shape only.

text.description: Text content (shape/text) or connector label. Replaces existing Y.Text on update.

color.description: Text color. Shape default `#000000` — keep unless the fill is dark, then pass a contrasting hex. Canvas text default `--affine-text-primary-color` (theme-adaptive). Shape/text.

fontSize.description: Font size (shape default 20, text default 16). Shape/text.

fontWeight.description: Font weight (shape default 600, text default 400). Shape/text.

sourceId.description: Connector source element id. Connector only.

targetId.description: Connector target element id. Connector only.

sourcePosition.description: Source [x,y]: relative [0-1] if sourceId set, absolute otherwise. Connector only.

targetPosition.description: Target [x,y]: relative [0-1] if targetId set, absolute otherwise. Connector only. When both source/target are bound by id and neither position is provided, endpoints snap to the BlockSuite side-midpoint facing the other endpoint so connectors flow in a clear direction. Pass [0.5,0] top, [0.5,1] bottom, [0,0.5] left, [1,0.5] right to force a specific side.

frontEndpointStyle.description: Front endpoint style (default None). Connector only.

rearEndpointStyle.description: Rear endpoint style (default Arrow). Connector only.

stroke.description: Connector stroke color (default '--affine-text-primary-color' — theme-adaptive, near-black in light / near-white in dark). Accepts any CSS color or AFFiNE palette token. Connector only.

label.description: Connector label (stored as text on the connector). Connector only.

index.description: BlockSuite fractional-index string controlling z-order. On add, defaults to a key above every existing element's index (new elements render on top). On update, replaces the stored value — pass a key less than some existing index to send-to-back, or greater to bring-to-front. Use the value returned by list_surface_elements to pick a specific position.

post.description:
Append document blocks with canonical types and legacy aliases (supports placement + strict validation).

_Hints: writes data._

Invoke with `tools/call` on `POST /mcp`.

workspaceId.description: AFFiNE workspace id. Omit only when AFFINE_WORKSPACE_ID is configured.

type.description: Block type. Canonical: paragraph|heading|quote|list|code|divider|callout|latex|table|bookmark|image|attachment|embed_youtube|embed_github|embed_figma|embed_loom|embed_html|embed_linked_doc|embed_synced_doc|embed_iframe|database|data_view|surface_ref|frame|edgeless_text|note. Legacy aliases remain supported.

insert.description: Text to insert. For a LinkedPage reference, use one ASCII space per reference (insert: " ").

attributes.description: Inline attributes. For a LinkedPage reference, use { reference: { type: "LinkedPage", pageId: "<docId>" } }; AFFiNE resolves the page label from pageId.

text.description: Block content as plain text or a delta array. For LinkedPage references, set insert to one ASCII space and pass the pageId in reference attributes; visible labels are resolved by AFFiNE.

url.description: URL for bookmark/embeds. Runtime validation also enforces provider-specific hosts.

pageId.description: Target page/doc id for linked/synced doc embeds

x.description: X position on the edgeless canvas for frame/edgeless_text/note (default 0). Prefer ≥40px between sibling bounds; BlockSuite does not auto-arrange.

y.description: Y position on the edgeless canvas for frame/edgeless_text/note (default 0).

height.description: Height for frame/edgeless_text/note. When `markdown` is set and height is omitted, an over-estimate is computed from the content — AFFiNE's render-time ResizeObserver corrects `prop:xywh` to the true DOM-measured height on first browser open.

background.description: Background for frame/note. Frame default 'transparent'. For notes, prefer AFFiNE's adaptive `--affine-note-background-<color>` family — `blue` / `purple` / `yellow` / `green` / `teal` / `red` / `orange` / `magenta` / `grey` / `white` / `black`. For specific per-theme colors, pass a `{light, dark}` hex object like `{light:'#fff', dark:'#252525'}`.

markdown.description: When type='note', parse this markdown into heading/paragraph/list/code child blocks inside the note (BlockSuite-native: mirrors what happens when you paste markdown into an edgeless note). Takes precedence over 'text' for note children. Ignored for other block types.

childElementIds.description: For type='frame' only. The frame's contents. Accepts ids of surface elements (shapes/connectors/groups) AND edgeless blocks (notes/frames/edgeless-text) — BlockSuite's prop:childElementIds holds both, matching what the editor writes when you drag a note into a frame. Dragging the frame drags every owned member. Ids that don't resolve come back under 'missing'. When width/height are omitted the frame is sized to the union of resolvable child bounds + padding + a 30px title band.

blockId.description: Block(s) to stack relative to. String = a single anchor; array = pick whichever is furthest in the stack direction (bottommost for 'down', rightmost for 'right', etc.).

gap.description: Gap in px between the anchor and the new block. Default is direction-aware: 80 for left/right, 40 for down/up — mirrors native-flowchart spacing where the flow axis gets more breathing room than the cross axis. Explicit `padding` on the block overrides this default; explicit `gap` wins over both.

stackAfter.description: Layout helper — position this block relative to one or more existing edgeless blocks. Picks the furthest anchor in `direction` for the stack axis, and centers the new block on the anchor group's union on the orthogonal axis (matches how BlockSuite aligns selection-derived blocks; reduces to inherit-anchor-x when widths match). Caller-provided x/y on the orthogonal axis still wins. Works for frame/note/edgeless_text. Example: `stackAfter: { blockId: [f1, f2, f3], gap: 80 }` stacks below whichever column frame ends lowest, centered across all three. Note heights shift at first render (page-root grows with the title, content notes shrink/grow with their children); give extra gap and fix up with `update_edgeless_block` if the down/right chain drifts.

padding.description: Default padding (px) for `childElementIds` auto-sizing on frames (each side, plus +30px title band) and fallback gap for `stackAfter` (default 40).

sourceId.description: Blob key returned by upload_blob for image/attachment

tableData.description: Plain-text cell contents for type='table', as rows of columns. Row count must equal `rows` and every row length must equal `columns`. Omit to create an empty table.

tableCellDeltas.description: Rich-text deltas per cell for type="table", parallel to `tableData` as [row][column][delta]. A cell with deltas here overrides plain text at the same position. LinkedPage references require insert: " " and a pageId in reference attributes.

viewMode.description: Initial data view preset for type=database or type=data_view. Defaults: database=table, data_view=kanban

checked.description: Todo state when type is todo

language.description: Code language when type is code

caption.description: Code caption when type is code

post.description:
Replace a frame block's contents wholesale. Accepts ids of surface elements (shapes/connectors/groups) AND edgeless blocks (notes/frames/edgeless-text) — all go into BlockSuite's prop:childElementIds map, matching what the editor writes when you drag members into a frame. Dragging the frame drags every owned member. Ids that don't resolve come back under 'missing'. By default the frame is resized to fit its new contents (plus padding + title band); set resizeToFit=false to leave xywh untouched. Pass `[]` to clear ownership (resize is skipped in that case).

_Hints: writes data._

Invoke with `tools/call` on `POST /mcp`.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID (optional if default set)

childElementIds.description: Full list of ids the frame should own/contain. Replaces any existing ownership.

resizeToFit.description: If true (default), recompute xywh from the union of resolvable child bounds + padding + title band. Set to false to preserve the frame's current box (useful when you want ownership-only edits or manual positioning).

padding.description: Padding (px) used when resizeToFit is true (default 40). Ignored when resizeToFit=false.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID (optional if default set)

fontWeight.description: Font weight (shape default 600, text default 400). Shape/text.

sourceId.description: Connector source element id. Connector only.

targetId.description: Connector target element id. Connector only.

sourcePosition.description: Source [x,y]: relative [0-1] if sourceId set, absolute otherwise. Connector only.

targetPosition.description: Target [x,y]: relative [0-1] if targetId set, absolute otherwise. Connector only. When both source/target are bound by id and neither position is provided, endpoints snap to the BlockSuite side-midpoint facing the other endpoint so connectors flow in a clear direction. Pass [0.5,0] top, [0.5,1] bottom, [0,0.5] left, [1,0.5] right to force a specific side.

frontEndpointStyle.description: Front endpoint style (default None). Connector only.

rearEndpointStyle.description: Rear endpoint style (default Arrow). Connector only.

stroke.description: Connector stroke color (default '--affine-text-primary-color' — theme-adaptive, near-black in light / near-white in dark). Accepts any CSS color or AFFiNE palette token. Connector only.

label.description: Connector label (stored as text on the connector). Connector only.

index.description: BlockSuite fractional-index string controlling z-order. On add, defaults to a key above every existing element's index (new elements render on top). On update, replaces the stored value — pass a key less than some existing index to send-to-back, or greater to bring-to-front. Use the value returned by list_surface_elements to pick a specific position.
